title: Unauthenticated direct access to https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/secure redirects to login
preconditions: No active session (no login cookie set / fresh browser context)
steps: Without logging in, navigate directly to https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/secure via the URL bar
expected_result: User is redirected to https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/login and a flash message "You must login to view the secure area!" is displayed. The secure area content is never shown.
